title: Core Persona Logic
summary: This module encapsulates the core logic for persona activations, dynamic gating mechanisms, and vector composition, driving the intelligent behavior of the chat and playground features.

nodes.label: Persona Activations
nodes.title: Extract & Manage Persona Activations
nodes.description: This module processes model outputs to extract and aggregate residual stream activations, quantifying how specific personas manifest internally within the language model.

nodes.label: Dynamic Gating Mechanisms
nodes.title: Orchestrate Dynamic Persona Gating
nodes.description: Manages multi-round agent interactions, dynamically applying and adjusting persona gates based on model output, streaming responses and trace information.

nodes.label: Vector Composition Tools
nodes.title: Compose & Analyze Steering Vectors
nodes.description: Provides command-line tools for composing, calibrating, and analyzing steering vectors, including generating steered response grids and performing orthogonalization.

nodes.label: D&D Playground Logic
nodes.title: Manage D&D Playground Configurations
nodes.description: Offers core logic for a D&D playground feature, retrieving specific configuration details like alpha values and best cell configurations for interactive sessions.

nodes.label: Language Model (LLM)
nodes.title: Underlying LLM Service
nodes.description: The core large language model service responsible for generating text responses, utilized by various components for conversational and steered features.

nodes.label: Persona Vectors & Data
nodes.title: Stored Persona Data & Vectors
nodes.description: Repository for pre-trained persona steering vectors, calibration data, and other structured information defining persona traits and their properties.

nodes.label: External Evaluation Services
nodes.title: AI Evaluation & Judging Services
nodes.description: External AI services (e.g., Vertex AI) used for judging model responses, evaluating coherence, and generating artifacts during persona development.

nodes.label: User-Facing API
nodes.title: API Endpoints for Users
nodes.description: The module exposing public API endpoints for chat interfaces, D&D playground sessions, and metadata retrieval, consuming the core persona logic.

nodes.label: Persona Dev & Evaluation
nodes.title: Persona Development & Evaluation Tools
nodes.description: The module containing tools for developing, evaluating, and demonstrating persona steering vectors, which heavily relies on the core persona logic.

groups.label: Core Logic Modules
groups.title: Internal Persona Logic Components
groups.description: These modules encapsulate the fundamental algorithms and functionalities for persona activation, dynamic gating, vector composition, and D&D playground configurations.

groups.label: External Dependencies
groups.title: Shared External Resources
groups.description: Critical external systems and data stores that provide essential services or data, such as the language model, stored persona vectors, and evaluation platforms.

groups.label: Consumers of Logic
groups.title: Modules Utilizing Core Persona Logic
groups.description: These modules integrate and utilize the functionalities provided by the core persona logic to deliver user-facing features and support the persona development lifecycle.
